# Marketing Metrics Guide

## CTR

Clicks ÷ Impressions × 100

## CPC

Total Spend ÷ Clicks

## CPM

Total Spend ÷ Impressions × 1000

## CPL

Total Spend ÷ Leads

## CPA

Total Spend ÷ Conversions

## ROAS

Revenue ÷ Ad Spend

## Conversion Rate

Conversions ÷ Clicks × 100

## Frequency

Average number of times each person saw your ad.

## Reach

Unique people who saw your ad.

## Impressions

Total number of ad views.
